PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-stack-started-generating|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|USDT Payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe offers a robust payment processing system with support for 46 countries, but its restrictions leave out many creators. PayPal, on the other hand, has a more extensive reach, but its policies can lead to account suspensions and frozen funds. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy provide alternative solutions, but they may not be suitable for creators in restricted countries. Meanwhile, NOWPayments offers a seamless and secure payment processing experience with support for over 300 cryptocurrencies and no account suspensions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe explicitly excludes countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, leaving creators without a viable payment processing option. PayPal's policies can lead to account suspensions and frozen funds in these countries, making it unreliable. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy may not be available in these countries, and even if they are, their features may be limited. NOWPayments, however, offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows creators to process payments without relying on traditional payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe's payment processing fees can range from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 1.4% + $0.05 per transaction, depending on the payment method. PayPal's fees can range from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 1.9% + $0.20 per transaction. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have varying fees depending on the plan and features used. NOWPayments offers a flat 0.5% fee for cryptocurrency transactions, with no hidden fees or account suspensions.
NOWPayments offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows creators to process payments without relying on traditional payment processors.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Creators in restricted countries should choose NOWPayments for its sovereign commerce infrastructure and seamless payment processing experience. Those who value flexibility and control over customer data may prefer Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy, but should be aware of their limitations in restricted countries. Those who prioritize speed and low fees may prefer Stripe or PayPal, but should be cautious of their account suspension policies.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
NOWPayments' flat 0.5% fee for cryptocurrency transactions is a fraction of the fees charged by Stripe and PayPal.

Frequently Asked Questions
Is NOWPayments available in my country?
NOWPayments is available in over 195 countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. However, the availability of NOWPayments may depend on your country's cryptocurrency regulations.
What are the fees associated with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments offers a flat 0.5% fee for cryptocurrency transactions, with no hidden fees or account suspensions. This fee applies to all transactions, regardless of the cryptocurrency used.
Can I use NOWPayments with other payment processors?

NOWPayments is designed to be a standalone payment processing solution, and it is not recommended to use it with other payment processors. However, you can use other tools to integrate NOWPayments with your existing payment infrastructure.
How does NOWPayments handle customer data?

NOWPayments offers full ownership and control over customer data, with automatic cryptocurrency payment processing and instant delivery of digital products. You can store and manage customer data in your own database or using a third-party service.
Is NOWPayments compliant with data protection regulations?

NOWPayments is designed to be compliant with data protection regulations, including GDPR and CCPA. However, it is your responsibility to ensure that your use of NOWPayments complies with relevant regulations.
